title: Cambridge IELTS 15 Test 3 Writing Task 1
directions: You should spend about 20 minutes on this task.
prompt: The diagram below shows how instant noodles are manufactured.
scenario: The diagram shows the manufacturing process for instant noodles.
requirements: Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

visualData.title: Manufacturing instant noodles
notes: Flour is stored in silos and sent to a mixer, where water and oil are added.
The dough passes through rollers to form dough sheets, which are cut into dough strips and shaped into noodle discs.
The noodle discs are cooked in oil and dried, then placed into cups.
Vegetables and spices are added before the cups are labelled and sealed.
